sources.snippet: In this paper, we propose a transfer learning model for multi-label lung disease classification, where Radgraph parsing is used to parse for annotations within the CheXpert dataset's frontal radiographs. There have been growing efforts to create AI systems to assist radiologists in analyzing CXRs.
